Subject: Technical sequencing & validation checklist (edge carveout)

Marco — attaching our proposed sequencing and a high-level diagram. Key points: 

1) Pre-provisioning (Week 0–1):
- Secure IP allocation and transit gateway route tables; create dedicated VPC with restricted SGs.
- Stand up 4 dedicated nodes in the new cluster pool; run smoke tests with synthetic workloads.

2) Data sync & validation (Week 2):
- One-way data replication for historical embeddings; run parity checks on 10k sample queries.
- Validate KV cache partitioning and ensure isolation of prefix caches.

3) Cutover window (Week 3):
- 2-hour maintenance window per region (off-peak), staged by service — we’ll failover read traffic first then write paths.
- Post-cutover regression suite (30 min automated + 1 hr manual checks).

4) Billing & termination controls:
- New VPC billed separately; burst reservation will be an amendment line item with a 60-day opt-out window before full billing starts.

Open items for your ops team:
- Confirm access to your transit gateway admin (ARN) and preferred peering CIDRs.
- Schedule a 60-min tabletop run with our SREs the week before planned cutover.

I’ve attached the diagram (edge-vpc-carveout-diagram.png) and the staged SOW (staged-rollout-sow.xlsx).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
